title: Rare germline JAK/STAT variants in a Korean cohort amplify innate immune responses to vaccination.
authors: Lee, Hye Kyung; Cho, Gyuhyeok; Huh, Jin Won; Furth, Priscilla A; Kim, Jungwook; Hennighausen, Lothar
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AlphaFold 3预测JAK/STAT种系变异对蛋白互作的影响，但核心是免疫信号通路与疫苗反应，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: The JAK/STAT signaling pathway regulates cytokine-driven responses. Here we investigated the biological impact of germline single nucleotide variants in JAK kinases and STAT transcription factors in vaccine response. First, we applied a data-mining strategy to RNA-seq datasets from a Korean cohort to uncover JAK/STAT germline variants and analyzed their corresponding interferon transcriptomic responses. Ultra-rare variants associated with heightened interferon transcriptomic responses were identified. AlphaFold 3 predicted conformational alterations in these JAK and STAT variants, focusing on protein-protein interactions and receptor-complex assembly. Co-occurring variants in TYK2 and other interferon signaling regulators that could influence the impact of the JAK and STAT variants were explored. We found that data mining can reveal candidate germline variants with potential roles in innate immunity and assessed how analyzing vaccine-induced gene expression changes can serve as an in vivo method to functionally assess the biological significance of missense mutations in key immune signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: JAK/STAT信号通路调控细胞因子驱动的反应。在此，我们研究了JAK激酶和STAT转录因子中种系单核苷酸变异对疫苗反应的生物学影响。首先，我们对来自韩国队列的RNA-seq数据集应用数据挖掘策略，以揭示JAK/STAT种系变异，并分析其相应的干扰素转录组反应。我们鉴定了与增强的干扰素转录组反应相关的超罕见变异。AlphaFold 3预测了这些JAK和STAT变异中的构象改变，重点关注蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用和受体复合物组装。我们探讨了TYK2及其他干扰素信号调控因子中的共现变异，这些变异可能影响JAK和STAT变异的作用。我们发现，数据挖掘可以揭示在先天免疫中具有潜在作用的候选种系变异，并评估了分析疫苗诱导的基因表达变化如何作为一种体内方法，用于功能性地评估关键免疫信号通路中错义突变的生物学意义。
